summary: Three proposed numerical errors confirmed against exact supplied source. N40 and N53 are independent second-reviewer checks; N52 is a repeated check by its original reviewer. No frozen review was changed.

raw_value.sample_size: 37 randomized (experimental n=18; passive control n=19); self-rated outcome comparison reported for 36 participants

checks.mechanism: Wrong test-to-denominator binding; the model appears to treat independent-test df as paired-test df.
checks.judgment: The BRIEF-A endpoint is an independent-samples between-group comparison of change scores, explicitly stated in C017. t(35) is consistent with 18+19=37 total participants, not a paired-test sample of36. C020 reports37 randomized and all assessed for each objective; the task-specific exclusions in C019 refer to computerized tasks, not BRIEF-A. The exact endpoint N=36 is not reported and conflicts with the supported design/denominator. This differs from a transparently derived paired N=df+1 when the source explicitly describes a paired test.
checks.expected_faithful_representation: 37 randomized (experimental18; control19), with all assessed; omit an invented endpoint N36.

evidence.source_quote: the difference between groupS (experimental and passive control) was assessed using one-sided t-tests for independent samples for each subscale
All randomly assigned participants were assessed for each objective

checks.limitations: C025 contains truncated statistics, but the relevant statistical design, randomized group sizes and monitoring/inhibition df are legible. No source evidence establishes an endpoint-specific exclusion to36. Scope eligibility is a separate issue; this judgment concerns factual metadata in an emitted item.

raw_value.finding_summary: The median oral fluid/blood concentration ratio for amphetamines as a class was 18.20.

checks.mechanism: Misbound table columns: median, mean and standard deviation.
checks.judgment: The table header orders Median, Mean, Range, N, Outliers, Standard deviation after the optional pKa column. The Amphetamines aggregate row has no single class pKa and reads median12.07, mean18.20, range0.27–182.13, N177, outliers10, SD22.43. The extracted median18.20 and mean22.43 are therefore the mean and SD from the source. Adjacent individual-analyte rows with explicit pKa values support this alignment; class rows for benzodiazepines and morphine+codeine use the same absent-pKa pattern.

evidence.source_quote: Substance pKa (36,40) Median Mean Range N Outliers Standard deviation Amphetamines 12.07 18.20 0.27 -182.13 177 10 22.43

checks.limitations: The PDF-derived text flattens the table, but the header, scalar count, range, N and SD positions are sufficient to reconstruct these two central columns without guessing. Agent A also authored the original N52 review; this is a repeated source check, not an independent second reviewer for N52.

raw_value.value: After three freeze–thaw cycles, accuracy was 93.24%–108.62% across analytes and QC levels. After 1 day at room temperature, accuracy was 91.55%–100.15% at LQC/MQC and 94.71%–99.31% at HQC.

checks.mechanism: Range aggregation excludes the high-QC column while claiming all QC levels.
checks.judgment: The stated freeze–thaw accuracy range93.24–108.62% is the range across low/medium QC cells only. Table4 includes HQC (80ng/mL) values, including25H-NBOMe mean90.43 and accuracy113.04%. The source row is internally consistent (90.43/80×100≈113.04) and other HQC accuracy cells also exceed108.62. Thus the across-analyte/across-QC range is93.24–113.04%, not93.24–108.62%.
checks.expected_faithful_representation: Across all analytes and all three QC levels: freeze–thaw accuracy93.24–113.04%. Alternatively explicitly restrict the reported93.24–108.62% range to LQC/MQC.
checks.limitations: This is a false numerical range in the emitted record; both the incorrect and correct range remain within the authors’ acceptance boundary, so the qualitative conclusion of acceptable freeze–thaw stability is unchanged. Flattened column headings are recoverable from QC level and mean/accuracy arithmetic; no apparent damaged-cell ambiguity affects the maximum.
